title: Scientific immortality by cloning and memory transfer
statement: Per the canon, the Elohim practice scientific immortality: regrowth of the body from preserved cells with transfer of memory and personality, the mechanism by which the Eternals — including the Council's members — persist across the project's span, and the mechanism behind the canon's re-description of resurrection and judgment: the dead recreated from preserved records, with roughly 8,400 recreated humans living on the Planet of the Eternals; religious resurrection language is read as memory of this technology.

includes: The mechanism as canon-stated: cellular preservation, regrowth, memory-and-personality transfer; practical rather than metaphysical immortality
Its institutional carrier: the Eternals and the Council (woh-claim-0028's office rides on it), seated on the home system's second planet with the recreated humans
The re-description layer: biblical and traditional resurrection-and-judgment language read as memory or anticipation of this technology, in the same demystifying register as the rest of the framework
excludes: Any claim that present human cloning achieves memory transfer; the canon attributes the technology to the Elohim, and the corpus asserts no terrestrial capability
Personal-identity metaphysics; whether a recreation is the person is a philosophical question the record registers without resolving
The criteria of the canon's judgment (who is recreated and why) beyond what the canon states
Movement practices built on the doctrine (cell-sampling rites), which are organizational history, not this record's claim

source_references.locator: The scientific-immortality and resurrection-re-description passages; the eternal-life-by-science material of the messages
The Planet of the Eternals account: the Eternals, the recreated humans, the mechanism witnessed
The academic treatment of the movement's immortality doctrine

alternatives.statement: A recreation with transferred memories is a copy, not a continuation; the doctrine renames death rather than defeating it (the standing philosophical objection, which the record registers).
Biblical resurrection language is eschatological theology with its own development history; reading technology into it is category substitution.
The immortality doctrine functions sociologically (commitment, succession, authority) independent of any mechanism.

revision_triggers: Claim woh-claim-0001 is revised or retired.
The canon's fuller context changes the mechanism's description or the recreated-humans account.
Public prose begins asserting terrestrial capability or resolving the identity question, both of which this record excludes.
